hover_backgroundBar.name: Hover background bar
hover_backgroundBar.title: Hover to reveal a background bar
hover_backgroundBar.about: Hover over a bar to reveal an initially invisible background rectangle behind it. The background fades when the pointer moves away.

select_scatterplot.name: Select by data attribute
select_scatterplot.title: Select marks by attribute value
select_scatterplot.about: Click a circle to select and highlight matching countries in the scatterplot while dimming the rest. Selection is not cumulative.

cumuSelect_scatterplot.name: Select Cumulatively
cumuSelect_scatterplot.title: Select Cumulatively by data attribute
cumuSelect_scatterplot.about: Click a circle to select and highlight matching countries in the scatterplot while dimming the rest. Selection is cumulative.

brush_slopeGraph.name: Select by 1D axis brushes
brush_slopeGraph.title: Brush axes to highlight marks
brush_slopeGraph.about:
This visualization shows that on average, percentage of obesity is inversely correlated with the percentage of population having a bachelor degree or higher. Each line represents a U.S. state. The left axis represents the obesity percentages, the right axis represents the percentages of people with a higher education.
Original visualization created by Alberto Cairo.

Interaction: Brush on either y-axis or both to highlight states within the selected value range and fade the rest. The brush can be resized and moved to adjust the selection interactively. Hover a line to emphasize it and show a tooltip with the state name.

brush_scatterplot.name: Select by 2D rect brush
brush_scatterplot.title: Select multiple marks in 2D region
brush_scatterplot.about: Drag a rectangular brush over the scatterplot to select points in a 2D region. Selected countries stay emphasized while points outside the brushed region fade. The rectangle can be resized and moved to adjust the selection interactively.

brush_areaChart.name: Brush to highlight area
brush_areaChart.title: Brush to highlight a region of an area chart
brush_areaChart.about: Drag a horizontal brush across the area chart to highlight a time range. The selected region lights up in red while the rest of the chart remains in blue. Clear the brush to reset.

lassoSelect_scatterplot.name: Lasso select
lassoSelect_scatterplot.title: Select multiple marks in freeform area
lassoSelect_scatterplot.about: Click multiple points to create a polygon, press the escape key to close the polygon. Marks within the polygon are selected.

flowSelect_DAG.name: Flow select
flowSelect_DAG.title: Hover to highlight outgoing flow paths
flowSelect_DAG.about: This visualization shows a visual summary of play-by-play event logs of a basketball match in the form of a directed acyclic graph, computed using the SentenTree algorithm. Hover over a node to trace outgoing flow paths in the directed graph. Connected links are highlighted in orange so local dependency flow is easier to follow.

showLabels_multiLineChart.name: One label for each series
showLabels_multiLineChart.title: One label for each series
showLabels_multiLineChart.about: Move cursor to reveal price labels for a particular date. The label is hidden if no price is available for that date.

showTooltip_multiLineChart.name: One tooltip for all series
showTooltip_multiLineChart.title: One tooltip for all series
showTooltip_multiLineChart.about: Move cursor to reveal a tooltip displaying values for a particular date.

compare_scatterplot.name: Pin & Compare
compare_scatterplot.title: Select a baseline, then compare
compare_scatterplot.about: Click a country to pin it as the reference point, then hover over another country to compare their statistics.

coordinate_areaChart.name: Overview + detail
coordinate_areaChart.title: Brush Overview to update detail view
coordinate_areaChart.about: This demo links two coordinated views: a focus area chart and a context chart below it. Brushing the lower overview updates the time window shown in the upper detail view. The brush can be resized and moved to explore different time ranges while the area chart updates accordingly.

coordinate_splom.name: Brush + link
coordinate_splom.title: Brush to highlight across all cells
coordinate_splom.about: Brush one cell in the scatterplot matrix to define an x/y range selection. The same subset is highlighted across all other cells to support multidimensional comparison. The brush can be resized and moved to adjust the selection interactively.

coordinate_splom_pan.name: Coordinated panning
coordinate_splom_pan.title: Pan one cell to update all cells
coordinate_splom_pan.about: Drag to pan any cell in the scatterplot matrix and all other cells update their axis domains in sync. This preserves the relative positioning of marks across views so multidimensional structure remains easy to compare.

brush_showTable.name: Display brushed data in table
brush_showTable.title: Display brushed data in table
brush_showTable.about: Brush the scatter plot to display the data of selected marks in a table.

crossfilter_histograms.name: Crossfilter histograms
crossfilter_histograms.title: Brush one histogram to filter the others
crossfilter_histograms.about: Three linked histograms show the distribution of flight distance, delay, and departure hour. Grey bars represent all 2000 flights; steelblue bars represent the current selection. Brush any histogram to crossfilter the other two — the blue bars update instantly to reflect the subset of flights that match the selected range.

celeste.name: Celeste: Topology
celeste.title: Celeste
celeste.about: A force-directed topology view of the Celeste system with type-based node coloring and labeled components. The layout supports interactive graph exploration as clusters and links settle into structure.

celeste_1.name: Celeste_1
celeste_1.title: Celeste
celeste_1.about: An alternate force-directed architecture graph for Celeste that emphasizes component types with color and a legend. The simulation enables interactive inspection of connectivity patterns in the system.

celeste_2.name: Celeste: Chord
celeste_2.title: Celeste
celeste_2.about: A chord diagram of Celeste port relationships in a circular layout. Hovering ribbons and labels highlights specific connections and reveals details through tooltip feedback.

celeste_infographics.name: Celeste: Infographics
celeste_infographics.title: Celeste
celeste_infographics.about: An infographic-style system walkthrough showing how data moves through Celeste services and storage layers. Visual emphasis and labeling make flow paths and component roles easy to inspect.

reconfigure_dustMagnet.name: Dust and magnet
reconfigure_dustMagnet.title: Drag magnets to re-arrange data dusts
reconfigure_dustMagnet.about:
A recreation of the Dust & Magnet technique (Yi, Melton, Stasko & Jacko, 2005) applied to Fisher's iris flowers. Each flower is a dust particle, pulled toward each of the four measurement magnets in proportion to how large its value is for that measurement -- a flower with a long petal drifts toward the petal-length magnet, one with a narrow sepal drifts away from the sepal-width magnet.

Interaction: Drag any magnet to a new position and every flower re-settles at the weighted centroid of the (moved) magnets, revealing multivariate clusters and correlations that a single fixed axis layout can't show at once.

dynamic_binning.name: Dynamic binning
dynamic_binning.title: Dynamically change number of bins
dynamic_binning.about: Use the slider to dynamically adjust the number of bins in the histogram. The bar widths and heights update immediately to reflect the new binning.

reconfigure_edgeBundling.name: Edge bundle strength
reconfigure_edgeBundling.title: Use slider to change bundling strength
reconfigure_edgeBundling.about: Use the slider to reconfigure edge-bundling strength in the network visualization. Adjusting the parameter changes how tightly edges are bundled together.

reconfigure_gridLayout.name: Layout parameters
reconfigure_gridLayout.title: Adjust layout parameters
reconfigure_gridLayout.about: Interactive controls let you change waffle chart layout parameters such as column count, start corner, and fill direction. The grid recomputes immediately to show layout changes.

sort_lollipopChart.name: Mark order
sort_lollipopChart.title: Sort marks by attribute
sort_lollipopChart.about: Choose sorting attribute and order to reorder lollipop marks interactively. The chart can be sorted by crime rate or area in ascending or descending direction.

reconfigure_rangeExtent.name: Scale range
reconfigure_rangeExtent.title: Drag axis to change range extent
reconfigure_rangeExtent.about: Drag the x-axis labels or ticks to adjust the temporal range extent mapped to the x-axis in the Gantt view. The size of the bars and the axis content update accordingly.

encode_scatterplot.name: Change axis attribute
encode_scatterplot.title: Change data attribute mapped to axis
encode_scatterplot.about: Dropdown menus let you remap which data attributes are encoded on the x and y axes. This supports rapid exploration of different variable relationships in the same scatterplot.

filter_stackedAreaChart.name: Filter marks
filter_stackedAreaChart.title: Toggle mark visibility + auto re-layout
filter_stackedAreaChart.about: Toggle category checkboxes to filter industries included in the stacked area chart. This interaction isolates subsets so trends can be compared without visual clutter.

navigate_bubblePlot.name: Zoom and pan
navigate_bubblePlot.title: Zoom and pan a bubble plot
navigate_bubblePlot.about:
A visualization showing 1626 planets and which ones are habitable. Temperature should not be too hot or too cold. The mass also plays a role: a small planet can't have an atmosphere, while a large one will have a crushing atmosphere.
Original visualization by John Tomanio and Xaquin G.V., NGM STAFF.
Source: Abel Méndez, Planetary Habitability Laboratory, University of Puerto Rico at Arecibo.

Interaction: Use the mouse wheel to zoom and drag the background to pan, updating the x and y domains for exploratory navigation.

dimpVis.name: Drag to navigate through time
dimpVis.title: Drag mark to navigate through time
dimpVis.about: A recreation of the Vega demo demonstrating the DimpVis technique. Hovering over a mark (a country in a specific year) to show its trajectory over time. Dragging the mark navigates through time along the trajectory. All other marks are updated to reflect the new time.

derive_indexChart.name: Adjust baseline
derive_indexChart.title: Mouse move to adjust baseline date
derive_indexChart.about: Move the pointer along the timeline to choose a baseline date, then view all series re-indexed relative to that point. The chart derives percentage change from the selected baseline for comparison.

RC_VIS1.name: RC_VIS
RC_VIS1.title: Character Connections
RC_VIS1.about: An edge-bundled character network with a control to tune bundling strength. Hover interactions emphasize each node's local connections while de-emphasizing the rest of the graph.

IP_Theft.name: IP_Theft
IP_Theft.title: Infographic
IP_Theft.about: A staged infographic narrative of IP theft scenarios. Use keyboard navigation to step through attack phases and reveal each sequence progressively.

BarChartHorz.name: Bar Chart (Horizontal)
BarChartHorz.title: Real GDP Change in the US
BarChartHorz.about: Percent Change of U.S. Real Gross Domestic Product from Preceding Period. Data source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis

BarChartVert.name: Bar Chart (Vertical)
BarChartVert.title: Real GDP Change in the US
BarChartVert.about: Percent Change of U.S. Real Gross Domestic Product from Preceding Period. Data source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis

BoxPlot.name: Box Plot
BoxPlot.title: Monthly gasoline sales Jan - Dec 2020
BoxPlot.about:
Adjusted monthly gasoline sales in the U.S. in 2020.
Numbers are shown in millions of dollars.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau

Heatmap.name: Heat Map
Heatmap.title: Twenty Years of NBA Draft Picks
Heatmap.about: This chart colors each player by VORP (Value over Replacement Player), which converts the BPM rate into an estimate of each player's overall contribution to the team, measured vs. what a theoretical 'replacement player' would provide, where the 'replacement player' is defined as a player onminimum salary or not a normal vmember of a team's rotation. A VORP of -20 is used for players that did not play enough minutes. Original visualization by Russell Goldenberg at The Pudding.

IciclePlot.name: Icicle Plot
IciclePlot.title: Mascot.js file system
IciclePlot.about: A visualization of the folders and files in the Mascot code repository (version 1.12.1). The size of each rectangle represents the file size.

MosaicPlot.name: Mosaic Plot
MosaicPlot.title: Share of Women in Job Levels
MosaicPlot.about: This mosaic plot shows that the percentage of women declines as the job level goes higher. Original visualization by Emma Whyte.

TowerChart.name: Tower Chart
TowerChart.title: Presidential Election 2020
TowerChart.about:
This tower chart shows the results of the 2020 presidential election.
Blue represents Biden, red represents Trump.
Each rectangle represents a state that a candidate has won.
The x axis represents the margin of victory for each candidate in terms of popular vote (%).
The y axis represents the number of electoral votes.
Data source: National Archives

BubblePlot.name: Bubble Plot
BubblePlot.title: Habitable Planets
BubblePlot.about:
A visualization showing 1626 planets and which ones are habitable. Temperature should not be too hot or too cold. The mass also plays a role: a small planet can't have an atmosphere, while a large one will have a crushing atmosphere.
Original visualization by John Tomanio and Xaquin G.V., NGM STAFF.
Source: Abel Méndez, Planetary Habitability Laboratory, University of Puerto Rico at Arecibo.

DoughnutChart.name: Doughnut Chart
DoughnutChart.title: How do Americans Spend Their Time?
DoughnutChart.about: Average time spent across a number of common activities by Americans between 15 and 64. Data source: Our World in Data

PieChart.name: Pie Chart
PieChart.title: How do Americans Spend Their Time?
PieChart.about: Average time spent across a number of common activities by Americans between 15 and 64. Data source: Our World in Data

PointRangePlot.name: Point-Range Plot
PointRangePlot.title: Mean and Standard Deviation
PointRangePlot.about: Average time spent across a number of common activities by Americans between 15 and 64. Data source: Our World in Data

RadialBarChart.name: Radial Bar Chart
RadialBarChart.title: Monthly Gasoline Sales
RadialBarChart.about:
Adjusted monthly gasoline sales in the U.S. in 2020.
Numbers are shown in millions of dollars.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau

RoseChart.name: Rose Chart
RoseChart.title: Nightingale's Rose Diagram
RoseChart.about:
A reproduction of Florence Nightingale’s rose diagram.
Data Source: Nightingale, F., Farr, W., & Smith, A. (1859). A contribution to the sanitary history of the British army during the late war with Russia. John W. Parker and Son.

Scatterplot.name: Scatterplot
Scatterplot.title: GDP per capita vs. Life expectancy

Sunburst.name: Sunburst Chart
Sunburst.title: Mascot.js file system
Sunburst.about: A visualization of the folders and files in the Mascot code repository (version 1.12.1). The size of each rectangle represents the file size.

BumpChart.name: Bump Chart
BumpChart.title: Color popularity in new cars
BumpChart.about:
This bump chart shows how the rankings of new car colors change over the years in North America. The magenta color denotes 'other' colors.
Original visualization by Rody Zakovich

ConnectedScatterplot.name: Connected Scatter Plot
ConnectedScatterplot.title: Driving Shifts into Reverse
ConnectedScatterplot.about: the shifting relationship between the price of gas and the average number of miles driven in a year, adapted from Driving Shifts Into Reverse by Hannah Fairfield, The New York Times (May 2, 2010)

CyclePlot.name: Cycle Plot
CyclePlot.title: CO2 Concentration Cycle Plot
CyclePlot.about: Six decades of carbon dioxide concentration in the atmosphere from 1958 to 2022, with mean concentration for each decade.

DumbbellChart.name: Dumbbell Chart
DumbbellChart.title: Partisan Reactions on Mass Shooting
DumbbellChart.about:
This infographics shows the topics mentioned by the two parties after the Orlando nightclub shooting with a focus on the differences in terms of the number of times these topics are mentioned.
Original visualization by Lindsey Poulter
Image credit: DonkeyHotey

LineGraph.name: Line Graph 1
LineGraph.title: Daily Temperature (Max, Min, Mean)
LineGraph.about:
Daily temperature in Boston for 2015.
The light blue band indicates the range between the maximum and minimum temperatures.
The solid line represents the daily mean temperature.

LineGraph2.name: Line Graph 2
LineGraph2.title: Covid Cases: Reported and Forecast
LineGraph2.about:
Reported COVID-19 cases between 7/12/21 to 7/26/21 and forecase by four different models between 7/26/21 and 8/21/21.
The four models are: MIT-Cassandra, UCLA, JHU-CSSE, and Microsoft.
Data Source: Google Search for COVID-19 statistics and CDC

LollipopChart.name: Lollipop Chart
LollipopChart.title: London Borough Crime Rate
LollipopChart.about: Overall crime rate (number of crimes per 1000 people) in London between May 2019 and April 2022. Data source: crimerate.co.uk

MultiLineGraph.name: Multi-Line Graph
MultiLineGraph.title: Stock Market
MultiLineGraph.about: Monthly Stock Prices of four companies: Amazon, Apple, IBM and Microsoft from Jan 1, 2000 to Mar 1, 2010. Original visualization was composed using d3.js on d3noob.org

MultiLineGraph2.name: Multi-Line Graph 2
MultiLineGraph2.title: CO2 Concentrations
MultiLineGraph2.about: Six decades of carbon dioxide concentration in the atmosphere from 1958 to 2022. Original visualization by Gregor Aisch for Datawrapper.

ParallelCoordinates.name: Parallel Coordinates
ParallelCoordinates.title: Features of Cars
ParallelCoordinates.about: This visualization shows the the features of 406 cars. Original visualization appeared in Robert Spence's book Information Visualization: an Introduction, page 69.

PolarLineGraph.name: Polar Line Graph
PolarLineGraph.title: Rising CO2: Polar Keeling Curve
PolarLineGraph.about: Monthly atmospheric CO2 concentration at Mauna Loa Observatory (2006-2026, 240 months), plotted in true polar coordinates: angle encodes month-of-year (12 spokes, January at top, clockwise) and radial distance encodes the ppm concentration itself. Source: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory. Inspired by Ed Hawkin's Carbon Dioxide Spiral.

RangeChart.name: Range Chart
RangeChart.title: Boston Weather 2015
RangeChart.about:
This visualization shows daily maximum and minimum temperature for a year in Boston.
Original visualization by Timm Kekeritz of Raureif was in the Polar space, we demonstrate how to create similar designs in the Cartesian space.

SlopeGraph.name: Slope Graph
SlopeGraph.title: Obesity and Education
SlopeGraph.about:
This visualization shows that on average, percentage of obesity is inversely correlated with the percentage of population having a bachelor degree or higher. Each line represents a U.S. state. The left axis represents the obesity percentages, the right axis represents the percentages of people with a higher education.
Original visualization created by Alberto Cairo.

StringlineChart.name: Stringline Chart
StringlineChart.title: Caltrain Schedule
StringlineChart.about: This visualization shows the Caltrian timetable following the style of E. J. Marey's graphical schedule. Each line is a train, and the slope represents the speed of the train. The lines are colored by the type of train.

AreaChart.name: Area Chart 1
AreaChart.title: Bitcoin prices: 2013 to 2018
AreaChart.about: This visualization shows the evolution of the bitcoin price from 2013-04-28 to 2018-04-23. The original visualization was composed using d3.js on d3-graph-gallery.com.

AreaChart2.name: Area Chart 2
AreaChart2.title: NYT Net Income: 2009 - 2022
AreaChart2.about: This chart shows the New York Times' quarterly net income (in Millions of US $) history from 2009 to 2022. Data source: macrotrends.net.

RadarChart.name: Radar Chart
RadarChart.title: Monthly Gasoline Sales
RadarChart.about:
Adjusted monthly gasoline sales in the U.S. in 2020.
Numbers are shown in millions of dollars.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau

ridgelinePlot.name: Ridgeline Plot
ridgelinePlot.title: How People Perceive Probability
ridgelinePlot.about: On the /r/samplesize thread of reddit, questions like What probability would you assign to the phrase “Highly likely” were asked. Answers between 0 and 100 were recorded, and this visualization shows the distribution for each question. This idea originally comes from a publication of the CIA. Zoni Nation reproduced it using R. This visualization is based on an example from d3-graph-gallery.com

StackedAreaChart.name: Stacked Area Chart
StackedAreaChart.title: Unemployment by Industry
StackedAreaChart.about: This visualization shows the evolution of the number of unemployed people in four industries (Manufacturing, Leisure and hospitality, Business services and Construction) from 2000 to 2010. The original visualization was composed using d3.js on observablehq.com.

StackedAreaChart2.name: Stacked Area Chart 2
StackedAreaChart2.title: Mobile OS Shares
StackedAreaChart2.about: This visualization shows the percentage usage of various moible operating systems from 2008 to 2014.

StellarChart.name: Stellar Chart
StellarChart.title: Monthly Gasoline Sales
StellarChart.about:
Adjusted monthly gasoline sales in the U.S. in 2020.
Numbers are shown in millions of dollars.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau

StreamGraph.name: StreamGraph
StreamGraph.title: Unemployment by Industry
StreamGraph.about: This visualization shows the evolution of the number of unemployed people in four industries (Manufacturing, Leisure and hospitality, Business services and Construction) from 2000 to 2010. The original visualization was composed using d3.js on observablehq.com.

ViolinPlot.name: Violin Plot
ViolinPlot.title: Setosa Sepal Length Distribution
ViolinPlot.about: This visualization shows the distribution for the sepal length of setosa, a type of iris plant. The data is from Iris Data Set.

ArcDiagram.name: Arc Diagram
ArcDiagram.title: Arc Diagram
ArcDiagram.about: An arc diagram showing the connections between Les Miserables characters, ordered first by group, then alphabetically.

DirectedAcyclicGraph.name: Directed Acyclic Graph
DirectedAcyclicGraph.title: UMD vs. UNC Basketball Game
DirectedAcyclicGraph.about: This visualization shows a visual summary of play-by-play event logs of a basketball match in the form of a directed acyclic graph, computed using the SentenTree algorithm.

Sankey.name: Sankey Diagram
Sankey.title: U.S. Energy Flow
Sankey.about: A Sankey diagram showing how energy flows from primary sources (coal, natural gas, solar, wind) through electricity generation to end-use sectors (residential, commercial, industrial) and finally to specific uses (heating, lighting, appliances, machinery, processes). Node height and link thickness are proportional to flow volume.

SeqSynopsis.name: Sequence Synopsis
SeqSynopsis.title: Sequence Synopsis
SeqSynopsis.about: Sequential patterns mined using the Sequence Synopsis approached described in this paper

TidyTree.name: 'Tidy' Tree
TidyTree.title: Node-link tree
TidyTree.about: Node-link visualization of a tree usign the Reingold-Tilford 'tidy' layout algorithm.

Isotype.name: Isotype
Isotype.title: Age Distribution as Human Icons
Isotype.about: An isotype chart showing 100 people grouped by age bin. Each repeated human icon represents one person, and the icons are classified into age groups using a grid layout within each group.

IconArray2.name: Icon Array (counts, image)
IconArray2.title: Icon Array
IconArray2.about: An icon array built from group counts specified directly in code (e.g. {colored: 15, gray: 20}) rather than a table, using msc.repeat's new count-map support. Each icon's image is encoded from the resulting 'group' attribute via the src channel and a mapping.

IconArrayCircularLayout.name: Icon Array (counts, symbol)
IconArrayCircularLayout.title: Icon Array
IconArrayCircularLayout.about: The same icon-array data as the Icon Array demos above, but using the 'symbol' mark -- an inline SVG path geometry -- instead of an external image file, arranged with the 'circular' layout instead of a grid. Each icon's shape is encoded from a 'group' attribute (filled vs. empty) via the path channel and a mapping, swapping between a filled and outline heart authored in the same viewBox. Five panels compare every value of CircularLayout's markRotation option (inward, outward, tangentialClockwise, tangentialCounterClockwise, upright), each of which orients the hearts differently as they go around the ring without ever changing their exact position.

IconArray1.name: Icon Array (table, image)
IconArray1.title: Icon Array
IconArray1.about: An icon array created by repeating one human image mark over a small data table, with each icon's image encoded from a 'group' attribute (Colored vs. Grey) via the src channel and a mapping.

IsotypeComparison.name: Isotype Comparison Chart
IsotypeComparison.title: An Unprecedented Death Toll in Qatar
IsotypeComparison.about: Recreates a Washington Post Wonkblog isotype chart comparing migrant worker deaths in Qatar to worker deaths during the construction of six recent Olympics/World Cup host venues, using one constant-size repeated human icon per worker death (the defining Isotype convention: quantity shown via icon count, never icon size). The Qatar section nests 1,200 icons into 12 blocks of 100 (each a 20x5 grid, arranged in a 3x4 grid); the six comparison groups mirror that structure with a repeated title+subtitle glyph column-aligned to its icon block via msc.affix. Counts are illustrative approximations of the original infographic. Sources for the original figures: The Guardian, Building and Wood Workers International, WorkSafe British Columbia, Al Jazeera, The New York Times, International Trade Union Confederation.

GridAreaChart.name: Area Charts 1
GridAreaChart.title: Unemployment: 2000 to 2010
GridAreaChart.about: This visualization shows the evolution of the number of unemployed people in four industries (Manufacturing, Leisure and hospitality, Business services and Construction) from 2000 to 2010.

MultipleAreaCharts.name: Area Charts 2
MultipleAreaCharts.title: Red and Blue America
MultipleAreaCharts.about: This visualization shows how the partisan voter index (PVI) for each U.S. state changed in the elections from 1980 to 2012. Original visualization by Randy Yeip, Stuart A. Thompson and Will Welch.

MultipleBarCharts.name: Bar Charts
MultipleBarCharts.title: Unemployment Rates by State
MultipleBarCharts.about:
This visualization shows how the unemployment rate for each U.S. state changed from 1980 to 2015 at five-year intervals.
The height of bar represents the difference of unemployment rate from the national average. Data source: Federal Reserve Bank.

MultipleBoxPlots.name: Box Plots
MultipleBoxPlots.title: Gender Pay Gap
MultipleBoxPlots.about:
This box and whisker plot shows the disparity in annual income for women vs. men across pay grades.
Original visualization from Now You See It by Stephen Few.

MultipleLineGraphs.name: Line Graphs
MultipleLineGraphs.title: Stock Market
MultipleLineGraphs.about: Monthly Stock Prices of four companies: Amazon, Apple, IBM and Microsoft from Jan 1, 2000 to Mar 1, 2010.

MultiplePieCharts.name: Pie Charts
MultiplePieCharts.title: Household Spending Patterns
MultiplePieCharts.about: Comparing household spending patterns in the UK and New Zealand in 1980 and 2008. Data source is here.

ScatterplotMatrix.name: Scatterplot Matrix
ScatterplotMatrix.title: Iris Species: Sepal and Petal
ScatterplotMatrix.about: Four measurements (sepal length, sepal width, petal length, petal width) for 150 flowers representing three species of iris (Iris setosa, versicolor and virginica)

MultipleViolinPlots.name: Violin Plots
MultipleViolinPlots.title: Iris Sepal Length Distribution
MultipleViolinPlots.about: This visualization shows the distributions for the sepal length of three types of iris plant: setosa, versicolor and virginica. The data is from Iris Data Set.

MultipleWaffleCharts.name: Waffle Charts
MultipleWaffleCharts.title: Life Expectancy in Each Country
MultipleWaffleCharts.about: This visualization shows whether each country's life expectancy is above or below 60, grouped by continent.
